name: typography
useFor: Use for running text and document pages (a site report, a method note). H1 is the page title, H3 a section or progress title, Lead the line under a page title, Muted an annotation. Set parcel IDs, coordinates and commands in TypographyInlineCode. For data, use Table.
constraints: Body text above 14px in the product
source: Brand type rules (Gilroy Regular and Medium, 1.4 line height) and Figma UI · Progress (442:213): the 24px title, at the product scale
